facts.fact: StackAdapt's blog post dated June 16, 2020 says the company added new CTV features and partners in the first half of 2020.
facts.quote: Here’s a roundup of what we’ve rolled out in the first half of 2020.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states it provides direct access to every major CTV/OTT source in the ecosystem, including SpotX, Telaria, RhythmOne, Beachfront, Freewheel and Xandr.
facts.quote: Direct access to every major CTV/OTT source in the ecosystem, including SpotX, Telaria, RhythmOne, Beachfront, Freewheel, Xandr and many more.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's existing CTV targeting partners as of June 2020 were Samba TV, TVision Audiences and Nielsen TV Segments.
facts.quote: To the existing list of partners for targeting—Samba TV, TVision Audiences and Nielsen TV Segments—we have partnered with Comscore

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt, Comscore's linear TV viewing data is collected passively from 99% of all US zip codes.
facts.quote: Comscore leverages passively-collected linear television viewing information from 99% of all US zip codes.

facts.fact: StackAdapt says its CTV reporting is available down to the single impression level with no tail aggregates.
facts.quote: Reporting is available down to the single impression level—there are no tail aggregates.

facts.fact: StackAdapt lists CTV metrics in its reporting as impressions delivered, CPCV, VCR, unique device breakdown and view-through conversions.
facts.quote: Comprehensive CTV metrics in StackAdapt include impressions delivered, CPCV, VCR, unique device breakdown and view-through conversions.
